description.text:
Given an array of points where points[i] = [xi, yi] represents a point on the X-Y plane and an integer k, return the k closest points to the origin (0, 0).

The distance between two points on the X-Y plane is the Euclidean distance (i.e., √(x1 - x2)² + (y1 - y2)²).

You may return the answer in any order. The answer is guaranteed to be unique (except for the order that it is in).
notes: Imported automatically from third-party problem datasets.

examples.explanation: The distance between (1, 3) and the origin is sqrt(10). The distance between (-2, 2) and the origin is sqrt(8). Since sqrt(8) < sqrt(10), (-2, 2) is closer to the origin. We only want the closest k = 1 points from the origin, so the answer is just [[-2,2]].
The answer [[-2,4],[3,3]] would also be accepted.
